key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) accounts for delayed and missing feedback while targeting long-term risk guarantees under limited tracking capacity.
engineering_relevance: CA-OCRC supports uncertainty-aware prediction systems where feedback arrives late and only a limited number of pending predictions can be tracked.
method: Sample proxy delays to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Use inverse probability weighting to compensate for feedback lost through delays or capacity limits.
Optimize the proxy delay distribution using risk bounds for arbitrary and stochastic delays.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluations in medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, showing effectiveness against existing OCRC methods without specifying numerical gains.
watch_item: Tracking-policy design must balance feedback collection against capacity saturation; matching unlimited-feedback long-term risk depends on sufficient capacity under the derived scaling laws.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
